description: Use this when the user asks when UAE e-invoicing starts, when they must appoint a service provider, whether e-invoicing applies to them, or the penalties. The UAE e-invoicing mandate: go-live and service-provider (ASP) deadlines for each group of businesses, days left, scope, exclusions and penalties, with official sources. Give who the business sells to, its annual revenue band and whether it is a government entity to get the dates that apply to it. Do not use it for the list of accredited providers (list_accredited_service_providers) or to check an invoice's fields (check_einvoicing_readiness).
name: einvoicing_timeline
title: UAE e-invoicing timeline
